body.value: 藩制一覽表第九（成羽、苗木）
藩制一覧表 第九（成羽、苗木）／はんせいいちらんひょう だいきゅう（なりわ、なえぎ）

Running header in the outer margin: Han-sei Ichiran-hyō, Fascicle 9, with the parenthetical (Nariwa, Naegi) naming the two domains whose maru-markers open on this leaf. Provenance only, not data. Note that it does NOT name 長島藩, whose officials and troop line occupy the right half of the page — that entry is closing here, having opened on an earlier leaf. Ink measured x2218-2276, y1274-1960; box pads 10px.
藩制一覽表第九（成羽、苗木）
三百六十六
三百六十六／さんびゃくろくじゅうろく

Printed book-page (folio) number 366, low in the outer margin. Checked at 2.2x: the fourth glyph is a plain cross 十 with no slanted top stroke, so the value is 366 and not 3,066. Ink measured x2194-2245, y3116-3362.
三百六十六
大參事
大参事／だいさんじ

Senior councillor (dai-sanji), the top domain-government rank under the 1869 han reform. Belongs to 長島藩, whose block is closing on this page: the column prints to the RIGHT of the ○成羽藩 marker. No 人數 count is printed against the rank here (the label band ends at y1247 and the count band below it is empty), but two appointees stand in the name registers below this column, 福原藏右衞門 (upper) and 吉見頼母 (lower). Ink measured x2094-2163, y1017-1247.
長島藩大參事
福原藏右衞門
福原蔵右衛門／ふくはら くらえもん

Appointee name, upper register of the 大參事 column: Fukuhara Kuraemon, senior councillor of Nagashima. Six glyphs; the first was zoomed to 6x and carries the 示 radical (福), the third is 艹 over 臧 (藏), and the fifth is the kyūjitai 衞. Ink measured x2073-2143, y2021-2584.
福原藏右衞門（長島藩分）
吉見頼母
吉見頼母／よしみ たのも

Appointee name, lower register of the 大參事 column: Yoshimi Tanomo, the second senior councillor of Nagashima. The third glyph was zoomed to 6x — its left element is a bare 束 with no 刀, and its right element carries a free top horizontal above the three-bar box, i.e. 頁 — so the printed form is 頼 (束+頁), not 賴. Ink measured x2060-2128, y2936-3502.
吉見頼母（長島藩分）
權大參事
権大参事／ごんだいさんじ

Acting senior councillor (gon-dai-sanji), the deputy grade of 大參事. Nagashima's, printing to the right of the ○成羽藩 marker. No headcount printed; two appointees follow in the registers below, 山田新右衞門 (upper) and 伴勘九郎 (lower). Ink measured x1965-2031, y1014-1328.
長島藩權大參事
山田新右衞門
山田新右衛門／やまだ しんえもん
Appointee name, upper register of the 權大參事 column: Yamada Shin'emon, acting senior councillor of Nagashima. Ink measured x1946-2013, y2016-2581.
山田新右衞門（長島藩分）
伴　勘九郎
伴勘九郎／ばん かんくろう

Appointee name, lower register of the 權大參事 column: Ban Kankurō, the second acting senior councillor of Nagashima. A one-glyph surname set before the usual wide gap: 伴 y2935-3003, then 勘 y3188-3251, 九 y3318-3376, 郎 y3445-3504. Third glyph verified as 九 (rounded bending leg), not 七. Ink measured x1930-2001.
伴勘九郎（長島藩分）
少參事
少参事／しょうさんじ

Junior councillor (shō-sanji), the third domain-government grade. Nagashima's. No headcount printed; two appointees follow below, 久我兵右衞門 (upper) and 宮田彥兵衞 (lower). Ink measured x1827-1897, y1014-1245.
長島藩少參事
久我兵右衞門
久我兵右衛門／くが ひょうえもん
Appointee name, upper register of the 少參事 column: Kuga Hyōemon, junior councillor of Nagashima. Ink measured x1806-1880, y2016-2583.
久我兵右衞門（長島藩分）
宮田彦兵衞
宮田彦兵衛／みやた ひこべえ
Appointee name, lower register of the 少參事 column: Miyata Hikobē, the second junior councillor of Nagashima. Printed in kyūjitai 彥 and 衞. Ink measured x1788-1864, y2938-3506.
宮田彥兵衞（長島藩分）
權少參事
権少参事／ごんしょうさんじ

Acting junior councillor (gon-shō-sanji), the fourth and lowest councillor grade returned here. Nagashima's, and the last of its rank columns before the military line. No headcount printed; two appointees follow below, 中島夷則 (upper) and 石川央 (lower). Ink measured x1694-1764, y1010-1327.
長島藩權少參事
中島夷則
中島夷則／なかじま いそく

Appointee name, upper register of the 權少參事 column: Nakajima Isoku, acting junior councillor of Nagashima. Four glyphs set with the wide inter-name spacing used throughout this leaf: 中 y2017-2078, 島 y2183-2247, 夷 y2354-2415, 則 y2523-2581. Ink measured x1672-1744.
中島夷則（長島藩分）
石川　央
石川央／いしかわ ひろし

Appointee name, lower register of the 權少參事 column: Ishikawa Hiroshi, the second acting junior councillor of Nagashima. A one-glyph given name set after a wide gap: 石 y2940-3002, 川 y3140-3203, then blank down to 央 at y3441-3503. Ink measured x1656-1728.
石川央（長島藩分）
兵隊　二百十五人
兵隊 二百十五人／へいたい にひゃくじゅうごにん

Troops: 215 men. Nagashima's military line, closing its entry — it prints to the RIGHT of the ○成羽藩 marker (兵隊 at x1552-1631 against the marker at x1405-1495), so by the boundary rule it belongs to the preceding domain. Each numeral checked at 1.35x with gridlines: 二 y1348-1394, 百 y1426-1500, 十 y1500-1570 (a plain cross, not 千), 五 y1595-1650, 人 y1677-1736. This is the one cell MASTER extracts for this page (長島藩 兵隊 = 215 persons), and the scan agrees.
長島藩兵隊
○成羽藩
○成羽藩／なりわはん

Maru-marker opening the Nariwa-domain entry (Bitchū province). Columns to its LEFT — 大參事, 權大參事, 少參事, their eight appointees, and 兵隊 不詳 — are Nariwa's; the five columns to its RIGHT close the preceding domain, 長島藩. Glyphs measured x1405-1495: ○ y1340-1417, 成 y1447-1524, 羽 y1628-1707, 藩 y1801-1883.
○成羽藩
大參事　一人（三人）
大参事 一人（三人）／だいさんじ いちにん（さんにん）

Senior councillor (dai-sanji) of Nariwa: the manuscript prints 一人, and the 1928 editors set a small parenthetical （三人） to the right of the 一, correcting the figure to three. Three is right — three appointees stand below in this and the adjoining column: 田邊確彦 and 清水入衞 in the two registers here, 小川勇雄 in the upper register at x1131-1202. The gloss was zoomed to ~6x and encloses 三 above a small 人. Ink measured: label 大參事 x1273-1344 y1003-1233; count block x1267-1387 y1411-1582.
成羽藩大參事
田邊確彦
田辺確彦／たなべ かくひこ

Appointee name, upper register of Nariwa's 大參事 column: Tanabe Kakuhiko. The third glyph was zoomed to 7x and resolves as 石 on the left with 隹 under a lid on the right, i.e. 確. Ink measured x1248-1322, y2015-2575.
田邊確彦
清水入衞
清水入衛／しみず いりえ

Appointee name, lower register of Nariwa's 大參事 column: Shimizu Irie. The third glyph is the page's one genuine 人/入 trap; at 8x, set beside the two certain 人 on this page (the 人 of 二百十五人 and the 人 of 一人), it shows a flat horizontal overhang at the top left and a hooked right foot rather than a clean apex, so it is 入, not 人. Ink measured x1232-1308, y2930-3497.
清水入衞
小川勇雄
小川勇雄／おがわ いさお

Appointee name, third of Nariwa's senior councillors, printed in the upper register of the unlabelled overflow column immediately left of the 大參事 column (this column carries no rank label of its own and no lower-register name). Ink measured x1131-1202, y2007-2574.
小川勇雄
權大參事　一人
権大参事 一人／ごんだいさんじ いちにん

Acting senior councillor (gon-dai-sanji) of Nariwa: one man. This is the one rank on the page whose printed 一人 carries no editorial correction, and it matches the single name below, 田邊農夫也. Ink measured: label x1020-1093 y997-1312; count 一人 x1017-1082, with 一 at y1440-1453 and 人 at y1499-1559.
成羽藩權大參事
田邊農夫也
田辺農夫也／たなべ のぶや
Appointee name, upper register of Nariwa's 權大參事 column: Tanabe Nobuya, the domain's sole acting senior councillor. Five glyphs, ink measured x997-1071, y2008-2571.
田邊農夫也
少參事　一人（四）
少参事 一人（四）／しょうさんじ いちにん（し）

Junior councillor (shō-sanji) of Nariwa: the manuscript prints 一人 and the editors gloss （四）to the right of the 一, correcting the figure to four. Four is right — four appointees follow in the two columns to the left: 岡周齋 and 村瀬節造 at x855-939, 井上篤次 and 信原德太郎 at x723-814. Zoomed to ~6x the gloss encloses 四 alone, with no 人 inside the parentheses, unlike the 大參事 gloss. Ink measured: label x895-965 y999-1227; count block x891-1007 y1403-1560. The box's right edge is set at x1011 because this gloss and the neighbouring 田邊農夫也 column interleave by about 10px in x.
成羽藩少參事
岡　周齋
岡周斎／おか しゅうさい

Appointee name, upper register of Nariwa's 少參事 column: Oka Shūsai. Surname and given name are set with the wide gap used on this leaf: 岡 y2005-2066, then blank, then 周 and 齋 running to y2568. The last glyph is 齋 (with 示 inside), not 齊. Ink measured x870-939.
岡周齋
村瀬節造
村瀬節造／むらせ せつぞう

Appointee name, lower register of Nariwa's 少參事 column: Murase Setsuzō. The second glyph is heavily inked in; at 7x the water radical and a right-hand 頁 are clear but the middle element cannot be separated cleanly, so the 瀬/瀨 distinction is not resolvable at this impression — I record 瀬, consistent with the unambiguous 頼 (束+頁, no 刀) printed in 吉見頼母 on the same page. The third glyph at 7x shows an abbreviated 竹 head over 艮+卩 = 節. Ink measured x855-930, y2925-3491.
村瀬節造
井上篤次
井上篤次／いのうえ とくじ
Appointee name, upper register of the unlabelled overflow column carrying the third and fourth of Nariwa's four junior councillors: Inoue Tokuji. Ink measured x741-814, y1998-2559.
井上篤次
信原德太郎
信原徳太郎／のぶはら とくたろう

Appointee name, lower register of the overflow column: Nobuhara Tokutarō, the fourth of Nariwa's junior councillors and the last official named on this page. Printed with the kyūjitai 德 (horizontal stroke under 罒). Ink measured x723-796, y2916-3484.
信原德太郎
兵隊　不詳
兵隊 不詳／へいたい ふしょう

Troops: not detailed. Nariwa returned no troop figure — an absence note stands where the count would be. It closes Nariwa's block, immediately right of the ○苗木藩 marker at x472-565, so it belongs to Nariwa and not to Naegi. Ink measured x626-699: 兵隊 y991-1135, 不詳 y1330-1474.
成羽藩兵隊
○苗木藩
○苗木藩／なえぎはん

Maru-marker opening the Naegi-domain entry (Mino province). It is the leftmost printed element on the page and nothing stands to its left, so no Naegi data appears here — the domain's return begins on the facing leaf. Its presence is what makes the running header read （成羽、苗木）. Glyphs measured x472-565: ○ y1326-1403, 苗 y1439-1519, 木 y1615-1689, 藩 y1789-1871.
○苗木藩
